nota: Negative astronaut states. The Moon has no air with oxygen, so fire is impossible: warmth comes from electric heaters and the suit's insulation.

frio.desc: Suit temperature in the blue zone: you freeze, move slower and, after a few seconds, lose health.
frio.remedio: Go back to the habitat or wear the Thermal suit.
frio.consecuencia: Much slower · gathering slower · shivering · losing health

calor.desc: Suit temperature in the orange zone: you overheat, use more oxygen and, after a few seconds, lose health.
calor.remedio: Find shade, go inside, or wear the Reflective cape.
calor.consecuencia: Slower · burns O2 faster · losing health

radiacion.desc: High dose from a solar flare: you slowly lose health.
radiacion.remedio: Shelter in the habitat during flares or wear the Regolith shield.

miedo.desc: Alone, in the dark, with aliens nearby: your hands shake and repairs are slower.
miedo.remedio: Get close to light (habitat or towers).
miedo.consecuencia: Much slower · CAN'T RUN · flashlight flickers · hands shake (slow repairs)

cansancio.desc: You've been working outside too long: everything takes longer.
cansancio.remedio: Rest inside the habitat or use a Stimulant.
cansancio.consecuencia: Very slow · CAN'T RUN · gathering and repairs take longer

vertigo_gravedad.desc: Lunar 0.165g disorientation from working far from base: slower movement and gathering.
vertigo_gravedad.remedio: Return to the habitat or eat a Space Ration / Hot Meal.
vertigo_gravedad.consecuencia: You drift sideways while walking · the view sways

aislamiento.desc: Psychological strain from darkness and isolation: repairs take longer.
aislamiento.remedio: Stay near lit towers, rest in the habitat, or eat food.
aislamiento.consecuencia: Colours fade · sanity drops faster · slower work

panico.desc: High heart rate under stress: you burn more suit oxygen.
panico.remedio: Calm down in the habitat, use a Stimulant, or eat food.
panico.consecuencia: Heavy breathing burns O2 · you stumble in random directions
